title: Applicability, ownership and assurance accountability
objective: Material risks, regulatory assumptions, controls and unresolved gaps have explicit owners and recorded applicability decisions.
test_procedure: Sample a material risk and trace its applicability rationale, owner, control, required evidence and current conclusion.
failure_indicators: proposed legislation treated as current law
conditional requirement represented as universally applicable
material gap has no accountable owner
compliance conclusion cannot be traced to evidence

title: Architecture and critical-dependency mapping
objective: Control, telemetry, remote-management and evidence paths are documented with their critical dependencies and trust boundaries.
test_procedure: Trace one local-control path and one central telemetry path end to end and verify that every material dependency and trust transition appears in the architecture model.

title: Remote and privileged access control
objective: Remote and privileged actions affecting the energy-management function are restricted to authorised identities and remain attributable.
test_procedure: Trace a representative privileged action from authenticated identity through authorisation to the resulting event record.

title: Local control resilience and state integrity
objective: The defined local control function behaves predictably when central connectivity is lost and does not make an unexplained control transition.
expected_evidence: control output or set-point during interruption
test_procedure: Execute SCN-BACKEND-LOSS and compare baseline, interruption and recovery control states against SC-01 through SC-06.

title: Telemetry integrity and source attribution
objective: Material operational measurements can be attributed to a defined source and their availability and validity can be assessed during the scenario.
test_procedure: Trace grid, PV and battery measurements from simulated source to collected evidence and identify missing, stale or unexplained values.
failure_indicators: missing value cannot be distinguished from a valid value
stale telemetry is treated as current
required controller input is not captured

title: Event logging and time integrity
objective: Material connectivity, control and measurement events can be placed into a sufficiently reliable sequence for investigation and assurance.
test_procedure: Generate or observe a known state transition and verify that connectivity, measurement and control evidence can be ordered consistently.
failure_indicators: timestamps contradict one another without explanation
control output cannot be correlated with measurement state
scenario timing depends on an undocumented clock

title: Recovery and state reconciliation
objective: Restoration of central connectivity includes sufficient reconciliation to explain the resulting operational and telemetry state.
test_procedure: Restore the interrupted dependency and determine whether post-recovery state and any telemetry gap can be explained from the retained evidence.
failure_indicators: connectivity returns but state remains unexplained
recovery is declared solely because a process is reachable
material difference from baseline is not investigated

title: Open-source provenance and dependency governance
objective: The OpenEMS baseline and other material software dependencies have known provenance, version ownership and a repeatable update or risk decision process.
expected_evidence: upstream security and release monitoring approach
test_procedure: Reproduce the pinned OpenEMS Edge build from the recorded source revision and verify that provenance and generated artefact information are retained.
failure_indicators: build depends on undocumented manual state
material dependency has no update owner

title: Physical and environmental dependency coverage
objective: Physical access, power and environmental dependencies capable of defeating the local-control function are visible in the assurance scope.
test_procedure: Review the local-control dependency model and confirm that physical assumptions are documented rather than silently treated as trusted.
failure_indicators: simulation result represented as physical-resilience proof

title: Configuration and control-change traceability
objective: A change capable of altering control behaviour is identifiable, reviewable and reversible within the assurance environment.
test_procedure: Trace the configuration used by the scenario to Git history and the recorded technical baseline.
failure_indicators: control logic differs from recorded baseline
result cannot be tied to a configuration version

title: Assurance evidence integrity and lineage
objective: Evidence used for an assurance conclusion can be traced to its source, scenario, collection time and integrity record.
test_procedure: Select a reported finding and trace it backwards from conclusion to derived analysis, raw evidence file and integrity hash.
failure_indicators: finding has no raw evidence source
